title: Empty CODEREVIEW_PROVIDERS now falls through to saved config and can fail startup unexpectedly

finding.claim: Empty CODEREVIEW_PROVIDERS now falls through to saved config and can fail startup unexpectedly
finding.evidence: When no --provider is given, an empty providers env now uses 'or userconfig.default_provider_specs()' inside the same try block, so an operator who intentionally set the env empty no longer gets the previous built-in defaults and may instead hit a ValueError from saved config.
finding.recommendation: Preserve the old empty-env fallback behavior, or only consult saved config when the env variable is unset rather than empty. At minimum, distinguish invalid saved config from an explicit empty env override.

code_region.text:
providers = providers_override
    else:
        specs = args.provider
        if not specs:
            env = (os.environ.get("CODEREVIEW_PROVIDERS") or os.environ.get("REVIEWLOOP_PROVIDERS", ""))
            try:
                specs = [s.strip() for s in env.split(",")
                         if s.strip()] \
                    or userconfig.default_provider_specs()
            except ValueError as exc:
                print(f"codereview: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
                return 2
        if not specs:
            print(userconfig.NOT_SET_UP, file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        try:
            providers = build_providers(specs)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print(f"codereview: provider setup failed: {exc}",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            return 2

refutation.reason: No panel refutation was recorded for this finding — it reached the workup undisputed. The opposing/confirmatory position is the executed probe in SS3 of the packet: Env-precedence probe (`probes/closingB_registry_timeouts.py`, section 4): with CODEREVIEW_PROVIDERS set to the EMPTY string and a saved config present, seat resolution fell through to the SAVED CONFIG — the set-but-empty variable did not disable the saved setup. The claim's mechanism is confirmed as executed: the resolution treats empty as unset.
